summary:
The week the client came back and nobody was there. After five full days of total silence from ALTR (2026-09-18 to 2026-09-23 - not one message from anyone), Ronnie surfaced at 01:45 on 09-23 with a customs link and 'pending customs above', and Mica posted a content-upload reminder on 09-23. On 09-24 Liza reappeared after eight days away and did everything ALTR had asked of her, in eighty-nine minutes. She answered Michelle's 14-day-old content chase - 'I’ll get this done today will upload content' - and asked a direct question, 'What exactly you need , reels/ picks?'. She apologised to ALTR for ALTR's mess: 'Sorry for the delay in this . I lost the message from above'. She took Ronnie's customs - 'I can make these done today' - and delivered them 33 minutes later with a Dropbox link, 'Here the link' and 'All done ☑️'. And she wired money nobody had asked her for: 'Hey I have sent 1,5 k' with a receipt photo, 'Towards next month commission', then a second receipt at 17:21 - 'And one more' - and a new third-party sender name, 'These will be coming from Jose M Munoz Linss'.

Not one of her seventeen messages received a reply. Not the direct question about what content ALTR wants. Not the delivered customs. Not the two wires. Stephski did not post in this chat once this window - her last message on the account is 2026-09-16, which means her own explicit commitment from that day, 'Its currently in processing on hold ill let you know when it clears', is now nine days old with the $10,000 still unconfirmed. Last week's single genuine win - payment responsiveness - has been fully reversed in one window.

The most dangerous line in the file is seven words long: 'Also let me double check on this log in'. That is Liza replying to Michelle's 09-12 message - the one in which ALTR copied her own plaintext password '[REDACTED-PASSWORD]' out of the scrollback and re-published it into the group chat. She is now being sent back into that message to troubleshoot @Lizakovaal, an account she told ALTR was deleted on 08-30, twenty-six days ago, and which Vivek has never issued a single status line on since taking all three passwords on 08-31. She still does not know ALTR leaked her credential. She is about to go and look at it. Meanwhile Mica chased content for a THIRD time on 09-23 while those accounts remain dead, breaking the freeze the last two reports called for, and Ronnie broke 44 days of silence without one word about the OnlyFans flag he promised to investigate on 08-09. Derrek has now been silent 52 days, and the $5,000 under-credit the client found herself has gone 16 days unacknowledged.

The one thing that improved last window - Stephski's payment responsiveness - reversed completely: she posted nothing at all this week, her explicit 09-16 promise 'ill let you know when it clears' is 9 days unmet on a $10,000 wire that was left 'in processing on hold', and the two fresh wires Liza sent on 09-24 went unacknowledged. ALTR was silent in this chat for five consecutive days (09-18 to 09-23). Then the client re-engaged in force - 17 messages, the 14-day-old content chase answered, Ronnie's customs delivered in 33 minutes, an unprompted $1,500+ toward NEXT month's commission, an apology for a delay that was not hers - and received zero responses of any kind, including to a direct question, 'What exactly you need , reels/ picks?'. That is a worse pattern than last week's billing-only narrowing: she reached back and got nothing. NEW AND URGENT: 'Also let me double check on this log in' (09-24) sends her straight back into Michelle's 09-12 message containing her own plaintext password. Discovery is now imminent and nobody has told her, deleted either message, or rotated anything in 25 days. Content was chased a third time (Mica, 09-23) while three Instagram accounts still have no status at 26 days. Vivek 25 days silent, Derrek 52 days silent, the $5,000 error 16 days unacknowledged, invoice credits unnumbered for a seventh cycle. Held up only by the client: flawless payment conduct, fast delivery, warm tone, zero complaints, no invoice dispute. Every single failure this window was ALTR-side.
